pole_a.label: individual_locus
sentences: We give you the tools and resources to manage your own stress and build resilience.
Your wellbeing journey is personal, and we help you take charge of it.
Use our meditation and mindfulness app to look after your own mental health.
We encourage everyone to set their own boundaries and practice self-care.
Our wellness stipend lets you invest in whatever keeps you healthy.
We offer coaching and counseling so you can work on your own wellbeing.
It's up to you to unplug and recharge; we trust you to manage your energy.
We empower each person to prioritize their health however works best for them.

pole_b.label: structural_locus
sentences: We adjust staffing levels so no one has to carry work while they are off.
The organization absorbs peaks in workload rather than pushing them onto individuals.
We build coverage into every team so people can step away without returning to a backlog.
Rest is protected by how we schedule and resource the work, not left to each person to defend.
We set organization-wide limits on workload so recovery does not depend on personal willpower.
When demand spikes, we hire and redistribute rather than ask people to stretch.
Time away is planned into how we operate, so the burden never falls on the individual.
We change our processes and policies so wellbeing is a property of the system, not a personal task.
